entries:
I'm making a delicious soup with
well-stewed vegetables.

Since her yammering stops while she's
cooking, it's another bonus for me.

Even a young 'un like yourself will catch
cold if you get soaked by that cold rain.{VAR BE01}
Sit right down and have some soup,
why don't you?

That's nice. A young 'un like you
shouldn't be shy.{VAR BE01}

Have some soup now, dear.
It'll warm you up.{VAR BE01}

A soup jam-packed with healthy
vegetables. It's delicious!{VAR BE01}

If you go in the tall grass during
a storm, it might pop out.

Walking on the raised walkways
is more tiring than you think, right?

Granny's meals are always
nothing but vegetables!
